author: DeanoGinelli
quote:
Worst gta game in the franchise. Jason is the most boring character ever in video game history. Extremely slow and tedious start. You can tell its not the same writers as the previous games. It is not fun anymore.
Chores aint fun. All the other gta games was humorous and the only thing funny about this one is we all got conned out of our money thinking we were buying a gta game.
Im disappointed big time.
